limitations: Computed or indirect pointer aliases are not exhaustively resolved

initial_audit_counts.superseded_by: a2_body_boundary_extension; original raw failure reports are retained

reading_order.current_summary: Top-level checks include the 16200-byte fix; startup_lifecycle_extension is the latest normal-startup evidence.
reading_order.history: Earlier extension remaining/limitations lists describe their original observation stages and are superseded where later extensions provide explicit evidence. Historical tool hashes are snapshots, not current-file checks.
reading_order.scope: 566 native signatures verified; 4 x0=4 records unsupported. Local signature parity does not prove service acceptance.

completion_audit.scope: Current observed Keeta native mtgsig a0-a10/x0 semantics, explanation of a3=20/25, and executable future-version detection/update workflow. Future unknown algorithms and full device collector recreation are not claimed.

requirements.verified_meaning: Current main App ak configuration, used as original bytes in cryptographic derivation; not a device UUID
Full 16-byte request signature; only Body is capped at 16200 UTF-8 bytes
Provider parameter at +0x58, constructor default 20 and accepted configuration 25; not inferred from App version
Integer Unix seconds at signing time
Compressed/encrypted collection and runtime-state container; b2 is the per-sign sequence
Atomic cumulative SDK state bits, with documented resource/binding/nil-read branches
requirements.boundary: Direct-address scanning and known branches do not exhaust indirect aliases or all possible bits.

requirements.verified_meaning: Local XID candidate followed by server fingerprint info/report data.result
Local/cached DFP followed by validated server dfp, not a permanent account primary key
Encrypted cached SIUA profile; independent cipher/profile selection from a5
requirements.boundary: Codec parity does not recreate all original device collection inputs.

requirements.verified_meaning: Native session parameter 3,N; N=rand()%254+1 after srand(time(NULL)); not the per-sign sequence
Current native assembly writes integer 2; observed x0=4 has a different unsupported field layout
requirements.boundary: No universal x0 enumeration or x0=4 codec is claimed.

requirements.verified_meaning: Installed App/build and numeric regional store version checks; configuration and resource drift checked separately
Audit and compare check signature fields/types, embedded schemas, versions, profile/mode, request shape and coverage, observed configuration and resource tags
requirements.boundary: Only the captured interface coverage is validated; missing requests/observations do not pass.

requirements.verified_meaning: Current native signing parity plus complete passive startup/configuration observations with build/instruction guards
requirements.boundary: The probe signs locally; service acceptance is a separate release gate.

requirements.verified_meaning: Runnable device/release/audit/compare/native/config/observe-config commands; difference triage, supported profile update, tests, four-endpoint service acceptance and deployment/rollback sequence documented
requirements.boundary: On-demand workflow; no background monitor, automatic App installation or production deployment created.

completion_audit.historical_a3_boundary: The same build produced both values and native initialization explains the default/configured branches; the particular unrecorded initialization failure of an old a3=20 session cannot be retroactively proved.
